Title: [LSJ] Flow within the Mountain + Skin of Chameleon?

Messages.Author: ncr...@yahoo.com
Messages.Body:
So, my gargoyle, Ublo-satha, bleeds. My prey wakes his tapped vamp,
Madame Guil, and attempts to block. Ublo-satha plays Skin of the
Chameleon for +2 stealth and a maneuver in the resulting combat if
blocked. Madame Guil plays Quicken Sight for +2 intercept and a
maneuver in the resulting combat.

Combat happens. Both minions maneuver to their favorite range.
Ublo-satha's strike is Flow Within The Mountain to end combat and
continue as if unblocked.

Question: Madame Guil can still block (since she woke and can block as
if untapped for the entire action duration) without need for additional
cards (for intercept or to wake again), right? And, if she blocks
again, does each minion get its maneuver from the Quicken Sight and
Skin of Chameleon AGAIN in the second combat?

Thank you much

d:)

David Anderson

PS: I suppose this is relevant to other "action continues as if
unblocked" cards like Chameleon Colors, Mirror Image, Form of Mist,
Shadow Body, Toreador's Bane.
